name: Instant NGP-based Surface Rendering
aliases: Radiance Surface Rendering via Instant NGP
definition: A surface rendering method that repurposes the Instant NGP ray-marching code for surface rendering by returning the color of the first sample with an occupancy value exceeding 0.5.
summary: Instant NGP-based Surface Rendering repurposes Instant NGP infrastructure for explicit surface reconstruction by terminating rays at the first surface intersection, achieving a 2.4x average speedup over standard NeRF.
